TABLE.NAME: message_whatsapp_user
TABLE.COMMENT: WhatsApp phone number and opt-in of each user. Without a row with optin=1 nothing is ever sent to that user.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user this phone number belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: phone
FIELD.COMMENT: Phone number normalised to E.164, empty when it could not be resolved.

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the number came from: profile1, profile2, custom (custom profile field) or manual (typed by the user).

FIELD.NAME: optin
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the user consented to receive notifications on WhatsApp.

FIELD.NAME: optintime
FIELD.COMMENT: Time of the last change of optin, kept as evidence of the consent.

FIELD.NAME: verified
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the number passed the OTP verification. Informative until that phase ships.

FIELD.NAME: verifiedtime
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the number was verified.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: active, invalid (the provider rejected the number) or blocked (the user blocked the sender).

INDEX.NAME: phone
INDEX.COMMENT: Inbound webhooks and delivery reports arrive with the phone number, not with the user.

TABLE.NAME: message_whatsapp_queue
TABLE.COMMENT: Outgoing queue. send_message() only writes here; the send_queue scheduled task is the only thing that talks to the network.

FIELD.NAME: savedmessageid
FIELD.COMMENT: Id of the notification saved by core, when core saved one. No foreign key: core may delete it before we do.

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Frankenstyle component of the event, for example mod_assign.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Message provider name inside the component, for example assign_notification.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the notification belongs to, 0 when it is site wide.

FIELD.NAME: phone
FIELD.COMMENT: Destination in E.164, copied at enqueue time so that a later profile change does not rewrite history.

FIELD.NAME: templatekey
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the approved template used for this message.

FIELD.NAME: params
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON encoded list of the sanitised template parameters.

FIELD.NAME: url
FIELD.COMMENT: Target of the template button, normally the contexturl of the event.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, sending, sent, delivered, read, failed or skipped.

FIELD.NAME: attempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Delivery attempts already made, capped by the retry policy.

FIELD.NAME: nextattempt
FIELD.COMMENT: Not before this time, used by the exponential backoff and by the quiet hours.

FIELD.NAME: providermsgid
FIELD.COMMENT: Message id given by Meta or by the gateway, used to match the delivery reports.

FIELD.NAME: error
FIELD.COMMENT: Last error, for the admin report.

FIELD.NAME: pricingcategory
FIELD.COMMENT: Pricing category reported by Meta, for example utility or service.

FIELD.NAME: timesent
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the provider accepted the message.

FIELD.NAME: timestatus
FIELD.COMMENT: Time of the last delivery status change.

INDEX.NAME: status-nextattempt
INDEX.COMMENT: Used by send_queue to claim the rows that are due.

INDEX.NAME: providermsgid
INDEX.COMMENT: Used by the webhook and by sync_status to find the row of an incoming status.

INDEX.NAME: userid-timecreated
INDEX.COMMENT: Used by the per user daily cap.

INDEX.NAME: status-timecreated
INDEX.COMMENT: Used by cleanup to find terminal rows older than the retention period.

TABLE.NAME: message_whatsapp_click
TABLE.COMMENT: Clicks on the button of a sent template, registered by go.php.

FIELD.NAME: queueid
FIELD.COMMENT: Queue row whose button was clicked.

FIELD.NAME: useragent
FIELD.COMMENT: User agent of the click, optional.
